name: BHP Group Limited
content: BHP Group Limited is a leading global resources company headquartered in Melbourne, Australia. As one of the world's largest mining entities, it focuses on the discovery, acquisition, development, and marketing of natural resources. The company's operations primarily involve the production of iron ore, copper, and metallurgical coal, which are essential for global infrastructure and energy transition. BHP is committed to sustainable practices and plays a critical role in supplying the raw materials necessary for modern economic growth and the shift toward a lower-carbon future.

Officers

Mike HenryJanuary 2020

Chief Executive Officer

Mike Henry has over 30 years' experience in the resources industry. He joined BHP in 2003 and has held various senior leadership roles including President Operations Minerals Australia and Chief Operating Officer. He was appointed Chief Executive Officer in January 2020.

Vandita PantMarch 2024

Chief Financial Officer

Vandita Pant was appointed Chief Financial Officer in March 2024. She previously served as Chief Commercial Officer and has extensive experience in banking and finance, having held roles at ABN Amro and RBS before joining BHP in 2016.

Edgar BastoOctober 2022

Chief Operating Officer

Edgar Basto was appointed Chief Operating Officer in October 2022. He has been with BHP since 1989 and has held numerous leadership positions including President Minerals Australia and President Western Australia Iron Ore.

Johan van JaarsveldSeptember 2024

Chief Technical Officer

Johan van Jaarsveld was appointed Chief Technical Officer in September 2024. He previously served as Chief Development Officer and has a background in investment banking and resources strategy.

Alan Pangbourne1995

President & COO, Nickel Americas

Mr. Pangbourne has over 35 years of experience in the mining industry, including senior executive roles at Guyanese Gold Corp and Kinross Gold Corporation.

Alberto Calderon2006

Chief Commercial Officer

Alberto Calderon was appointed CEO of AngloGold Ashanti in September 2021. He was previously CEO of Orica and has held senior executive roles at BHP, including Group Executive and Chief Commercial Officer.

Andre Liebenberg

Various senior executive roles, including CFO of Energy Coal, Acting President of Energy Coal, and Head of Group Investor Relations.

Andre has over 30 years of experience in the resources industry. He was previously at BHP where he held various senior roles including Acting President of Energy Coal and Head of Group Investor Relations. Prior to BHP, he was at UBS in London and Old Mutual in South Africa.

Christine O'ReillyOctober 2020

Independent Non-executive Director

Christine O'Reilly has over 30 years' experience in financial and infrastructure sectors. She was previously CEO of the GasNet Group and Co-Head of Unlisted Infrastructure at Colonial First State Global Asset Management.

Diane Jurgens2015

Chief Technology Officer

Diane Jurgens is an independent non-executive director. She was formerly the CTO of BHP and has held senior leadership roles at The Walt Disney Company and General Motors.

Dion Weisler2020

Independent Non-Executive Director

Dion J. Weisler has been a director since 2020. He was President and CEO of HP Inc. from 2015 to 2019.

Ian Cockerill2019

Non-Executive Director

Ian Cockerill has over 45 years of experience in the global natural resources industry. He previously served as CEO of Gold Fields and Anglo Coal, and was a non-executive director of Endeavour since 2019 before being appointed CEO.

Lassina Zerbo1993

Research Geophysicist / Project Geophysicist (Africa programmes)

Dr. Zerbo is the former Executive Secretary of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty Organization (CTBTO) and has served as the Prime Minister of Burkina Faso. He is a renowned expert in nuclear non-proliferation and international diplomacy.

Michelle HinchliffeMarch 2022

Independent Non-executive Director

Michelle Hinchliffe was a partner at KPMG for 36 years, where she held several leadership roles including UK Chair of Audit. She has extensive experience in auditing and financial services.

Terry BowenSeptember 2017

Independent Non-executive Director

Terry Bowen is a former Finance Director of Wesfarmers Limited. He has over 25 years' experience in senior financial and executive roles across various industries.

Vicky Binns~2011

Executive Leadership Roles (various, including Vice President Minerals Marketing)

Ms. Binns has over 35 years’ experience in the global resources and financial services sectors, including 10 years at BHP in senior executive roles.

Xiaoqun Clever2020

Non-executive Director

Xiaoqun Clever has over 20 years' experience in technology and digital transformation. She has held senior executive roles at SAP SE and Ringier AG.

Gerard Bond1997

Various senior executive roles (including Deputy CFO of Aluminium, CFO and Acting President of Nickel, and Head of Group Human Resources)

Mr. Bond was appointed President and CEO in April 2022. He has over 25 years of experience in the global financial and resources industry, including 10 years at Newcrest Mining as CFO and several senior executive roles at BHP.

Michael Anglin1986

Vice President of Operations and Chief Operating Officer (Base Metals Group)

Lead Independent Director. Former executive at BHP Billiton with over 30 years of experience in the mining industry.

Michelle Du Plessis~2008

Various operational and strategic roles (including Global HR operations)

Ms. Du Plessis joined OceanaGold in 2022. She has over 20 years of experience in human resources and organizational development within the mining and resources sector.

Shaun VernerPrior to 2012

Vice President, Marketing (Coal and Base Metals)

Shaun Verner is a mining executive with over 30 years of experience in the resources industry. Prior to joining Syrah, he held senior roles at BHP, including in marketing, sales, and strategy. He has extensive experience in international markets and commodity trading.
